name: claude-speak
description: Text-to-speech for Claude Code. Hear a short spoken summary of every reply, voiced by Kokoro, a free local TTS model. No API key, works offline.

auto_speak.title: Speak every response
auto_speak.description: Speak each response aloud as soon as Claude finishes. Turn off to speak only when you run /speak. /speak-auto on|off overrides this.

summarize.title: Summarize before speaking
summarize.description: Speak a one or two sentence summary instead of the whole response. Short responses are always read in full.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: Kokoro voice, e.g. af_heart, af_bella, am_michael, bf_emma, bm_george. See the README for the full list.

summary_model.title: Summary model
summary_model.description: Claude model used to write the spoken summary.
